text:
Silver Price in 2024
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2024, the LBMA silver price rose 25.2% between 2024-01-31 ($23.09) and 2024-12-31 ($28.91). The highest sampled price was $33.59 in October and the lowest was $22.34 in February. The mean of these observations was $28.30. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
